title: Analista De Desenvolvimento E Suporte
description:
Analista De Desenvolvimento E Suporte

Join to apply for the Analista De Desenvolvimento E Suporte role at Tree - Soluções ESG Integradas

Local: Remoto / Híbrido (São Paulo - São Caetano do Sul)
Duração da bolsa: 8 meses
Carga horária: 40 horas semanais
Início previsto: Imediato
Valor da Bolsa: Conforme tabela FAPESP (nível TT-3)

Sobre o Projeto

Projeto "Software de Rastreabilidade via Blockchain de Logística Reversa Pós-Consumo", apoiado pela FAPESP. O objetivo é desenvolver uma solução digital para gestão logística e ambiental de resíduos sólidos, utilizando tecnologias como blockchain e contratos inteligentes, com foco em transparência, rastreabilidade e eficiência na logística reversa pós-consumo.

Atividades do Bolsista

  • Suporte Técnico Operacional: atendimento de primeiro nível a usuários, acompanhamento de coletas e rotinas operacionais, monitoramento do funcionamento da plataforma.
  • Testes e Validação: execução de testes manuais, registro de erros em ferramentas como Trello/Notion/GitHub Issues, simulação de cenários de uso real (incluindo APIs logísticas como Lalamove).
  • Coleta de Feedbacks & Documentação: interação com usuários, organização de tutoriais, FAQs e manuais de apoio.
  • Monitoramento de Indicadores: análise de métricas como tempo de resposta, número de falhas e nível de utilização da plataforma.
  • Interface com Equipes: apoio a times de desenvolvimento, atendimento e comercial, participação em reuniões de sprint e planejamento.

Requisitos

  • Formação técnica ou superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência de dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Habilidade para executar testes funcionais, registrar e documentar processos, interagir com usuários e fornecer suporte técnico.

Desejável Conhecimento Em

  • Node.js, Python, HTML, banco de dados (MySQL, Firebase Firestore), ferramentas de versionamento (Git) e metodologias ágeis.
  • Docker/Kubernetes (diferencial).

Impacto

Ao integrar a equipe, você contribuirá diretamente para a melhoria da logística reversa de resíduos pós-consumo, redução de custos, aumento da eficiência para empresas e desenvolvimento sustentável, conservação ambiental e incentivo à economia circular.

Como se candidatar

Envie seu currículo atualizado e uma breve carta de motivação para: (endereço de e‑mail) ou pelo portal de carreiras da Tree.

title: MANTENEDOR II (230)
description:
A Iqony Solutions do Brasil é uma subsidiária da Iqony Solutions GmbH, fornecedor conhecido internacionalmente pelos serviços especializados no setor energético, atuando em mais de 80 países em todo o mundo. Desde 2002, a Iqony Solutions do Brasil, com sede no Rio de Janeiro, oferece seus serviços nas áreas de Engenharia, Consultoria e Operação & Manutenção para clientes na América do Sul em usinas de geração de energia. O grupo é proprietário de aproximadamente 7.6 GW de capacidade instalada, incluindo plantas Eólicas, Térmicas, Solar, entre outras. Ao lado do investidor, oferecemos as melhores soluções para Engenharia e Operação & Manutenção. Atualmente, a Iqony Solutions GmbH opera mais de 6 GW de terceiros e 7.6 GW de plantas próprias. A Iqony Solutions do Brasil também oferece serviços no setor de energias renováveis com contratos no Brasil que somam mais de 5 GW. A empresa também possui um Centro de Operação e Monitoramento Remoto, situado no Rio de Janeiro.

A IQONY Solutions do Brasil Ltda assegura o compromisso de atuação com valorização e respeito aos direitos humanos, rejeitando todas as formas de discriminação, e está comprometida em promover a diversidade, inclusão e equidade de tratamento em todos os níveis e processos da organização, zelando por um ambiente saudável e equilibrado de trabalho. Nossos processos seletivos são abertos para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, orientação sexual, cor/raça, deficiências, religião, nacionalidade, naturalidade, idade ou quaisquer outras características pessoais.

Descrição

  • Executar atividades de manutenções preventivas, preditivas e corretivas em equipamentos de subestações, redes de média tensão, linha de transmissão e torres anemométricas, conforme plano de manutenção anual;
  • Executar ensaios elétricos em equipamentos de subestações, tais como Disjuntores, Transformadores, TC’s, TP’s, Chaves Seccionadoras, GMG, Bancos de Baterias, Reles de Proteção e Cubículos de média tensão e diagnóstico de falhas de equipamentos;
  • Identificar e reportar problemas observados durante as inspeções;
  • Elaboração de relatórios técnicos;
  • Suporte ao time de operação remota em caso de acionamentos para verificação de falhas;
  • Registra/reportar os defeitos encontrados no software de gestão da manutenção;
  • Abrir e fechar OS no software de gestão da manutenção;
  • Leitura e interpretação de projetos e diagramas elétricos (funcionais, lógicos e construtivos)
  • Atendimento ao sobreaviso conforme escala definida pela gestão de O&M
  • Registrar e reportar quaisquer incidentes (geração, segurança, ambiente ou HSE) detectados dentro das instalações
  • Cumprir com as regras de compliance e de ESG&HS.

Requisitos

  • Formação Técnica em eletrotécnica, elétrica, ou afins
  • Experiência com manutenção elétrica (de preferência experiência em usinas eólicas e/ou sistemas de potência).
  • Experiência com operação e manutenção de linhas de transmissão, redes de média tensão e equipamentos de média e alta tensão, tais como: transformadores de potência, transformadores de tensão e corrente, disjuntores, chaves seccionadoras, cubículos, barramentos, isoladores, etc.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em regime de escala 4x4.

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde Unimed
  • Plano Odontológico
  • PLR (Participação nos lucros e resultados, caso o resultado seja atingido)
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Transporte oferecido pela empresa

description:
Join to apply for the Marketing Operations QA Specialist role at Launch Potato.

WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data‑driven content and technology. Headquartered in South Florida with a remote‑first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high‑growth, high‑performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high‑performers.

CONTRACT NON‑NEGOTIABLES

  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday – Friday.
  • Comfortable to work between 7:00 am and 6:00 pm Eastern Standard Time.
  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills in English, both written and spoken.
  • Highly detail‑oriented and reliable.
  • Excellent administrative skills with the ability to multitask and adapt in a fast‑paced remote environment.

BASE SALARY

$1,500 – $2,500 (USD) per month.

YOUR ROLE

You are a detail‑oriented, results‑driven professional with a passion for maintaining the highest standards of quality and efficiency in operational processes and procedures. Everything goes through QA, so you will be directly responsible for ensuring the success of our campaign launches, which connect millions of consumers to our clients monthly. You will also oversee and optimize our operations to meet and exceed industry standards and organizational objectives. Your unwavering attention to detail and thorough analysis skills will be invaluable in detecting and identifying potential problems within our daily operations. You have a proven track record in quality management, process improvement, and possess industry‑specific knowledge. Your ability to collaborate and work cross‑functionally, leveraging your industry‑specific expertise, will enable you to implement effective solutions and make a significant impact on our company’s operational excellence.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Supporting quality assurance for our financebuzz.com and allaboutcookies.org domains.
  • Maintaining the process for building, setting up, and testing tracking URLs across all campaigns and platforms to ensure the highest quality.
  • Reconciling reporting between our internal tracking platforms and external client platforms to ensure proper tracking.
  • Conducting investigations when there is an offer discrepancy or malfunction and finding suitable resolutions.
  • Reviewing platform documentation and internal product setup to find areas of improvement and working with the Operations team to determine next steps to close the gap.
  • Working closely with the Operations team to ensure QA standards are consistently met.
  • Communicating with internal stakeholders on process improvements.
  • Analyzing ad‑hoc performance reports to improve company efficiency of revenue delivery, product improvement, or general site issues.
  • Monitoring revenue, conversions, impressions, and clicks to ensure proper reporting when a new offer is created, links are changed, or in other necessary circumstances.
  • Monitoring offer goals to ensure all goals are firing properly after creation.
  • Ensuring QA is successfully implemented with any new process that is rolled out.
  • Quickly becoming a subject‑matter expert for all QA‑related processes.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

  • 2–3 years in operations or quality assurance with expertise in digital media advertising.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Understanding of Postback URL tracking and other performance marketing methods of tracking.
  • Experience with Tune & Yieldspark or similar tracking tools.
  • Experience with Asana or other project management tools.
  • Experience with Looker or similar BI tools like Tableau or PowerBI.
  • Proven ability to analyze performance reports to improve company efficiency of revenue delivery, product improvement, or general site issues.
  • Proven problem‑solving ability and #BetterEveryDay mindset.
  • Proactive mindset, searching for opportunities, not just being given tasks/tickets.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to work East Coast hours consistently.

APPLY NOW!

Since day one, we’ve been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, or other legally protected characteristics.

We are looking for a Junior Tax Analyst to support our Tax Team with Brazilian tax demands. Como um Analista de Customer Success Sênior na Equinix, o profissional atuará de forma estratégica em três pilares fundamentais para o negócio:

  • Relacionamento com Clientes Field Sales: prestará atendimento direto aos clientes das contas de Field Sales — clientes estratégicos e de grande porte da Equinix, garantindo uma experiência de excelência desde o primeiro contato.

  2. Fase 2 – Reunião Inicial: Agendará, facilitará e conduzirá reuniões de início de integração.
  3. Fase 3 – Acompanhamento Contínuo: Estabelecerá uma cadência regular de contato para acompanhar a evolução dos clientes.

Poderá liderar integrações em diferentes regiões, em parceria com outros Gerentes de Sucesso do Cliente (CSMs).

Coletará e gerenciará feedbacks, propondo melhorias contínuas com base nas percepções dos clientes.

Garantirá transições suaves entre áreas internas.

Atuará junto às partes interessadas para assegurar o cumprimento de políticas e procedimentos.

Comunicará resoluções e planos de melhoria com clareza e empatia.

Gestão e Retenção de Contas

Participará da gestão de contas em parceria com as áreas de vendas e gestão.

Apoiará o cumprimento de obrigações contratuais.

Identificará riscos de churn de forma proativa e contribuirá com estratégias de retenção.

  • 1Identify potential sources of hazard prior to dismantling.

  • 4Identify, check and prepare components.
  • 5Apply appropriate tests and test equipment to ensure reassembly is correct and effective.
  • 2) Monitor and Maintain the condition of Instrumentation Equipment.
  • 1Adjust instruments to meet the operating specification.
  • 2Adjust with minimum disruption to any ongoing activities and minimum waste of resources.
  • 3Monitor and record what has been carried out in work history or log.

  • 1Respond promptly to problems in line with approved procedures.
  • 2Select appropriate tests and diagnostic procedures and apply them methodically.
  • 3Carry out Visual, Close and Detailed inspections on ”˜Ex” equipment.
  • 4Use the results of inspections to determine the appropriate actions to take.
  • 5Record an accurate and full description in the appropriate document history.
  • 4) Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures.
  • 1Unplanned discharges to the environment are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to policy, procedure and regulation.
  • 2Relevant PPE is used to deal with unplanned discharges using company procedures.
  • 3Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
  • 4Environmental protection and pollution control are enforced effectively with colleagues, subordinates and subcontractors.
  • 5) Emergency Response
  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.
  • Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Most of Carta's long‑term success will come from products and technology that have yet to be built. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

  • Building customer‑facing enterprise tools for equity administration
  • Creating data pipelines for asynchronously aggregating financial reports
  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third‑party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event‑driven services
  • And others for you to discover and champion

You’ll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we’re building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross‑functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript and any backend language
  • You may be familiar with some additional elements of the Carta tech stack (Python, Django, React, Postgres, GRPC, Kafka, docker, K8, AWS)

The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list). Finally, you'll have back‑to‑back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

About The Job

Better Cotton Initiative (BCI) is the world’s largest cotton sustainability initiative – we support more sustainable farming practices and farm livelihoods for nearly 3 million farmers in the Better Cotton network in 23 countries around the world. BCI works across all farm sizes and geographies. It is crucial that Better Cotton producers, and the cotton they produce, can continue to access international markets in the face of changing regulatory and business expectations. Are you purpose‑led and ready to embark on a journey to shape the future of sustainable cotton? Join us at Better Cotton as Membership & Supply Chain Officer, LATAM & Portugal and support member engagement and the implementation of Better Cotton’s supply chain systems across the LATAM and Portugal region.

The Challenge

Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improve soil health across our network, improve farm income, and support women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.

Responsibilities

  • Provide high‑quality administrative support to the LATAM/Portugal Team and support reporting for the region.

Membership Engagement & Support

  • Respond to stakeholder queries via Helpdesk and elevate when needed.
  • Support external communications and raise awareness of Better Cotton initiatives.

Supply Chain Operations

  • Monitor and troubleshoot account creation and transaction processes.
  • Clean and validate data to ensure system accuracy and compliance.

  • Deliver supplier training programs (online and in‑person).
  • Collaborate with internal teams to improve tools and processes.

Reporting & Administration

  • Provide high‑quality administrative support to the LATAM/Portugal team.
  • Support regional reporting and performance monitoring.
  • Translate and adapt tools and documents for cultural and linguistic relevance.

Essential

  • Customer service orientation – for account creation, data validation, and stakeholder management.
  • Data analysis and reporting – advanced Excel functions.
  • Event and training organization and delivery – for online and in‑person training programs and stakeholder events.
  • Documentation and compliance review – for onboarding and membership processing.
  • Helpdesk systems and procedures – for managing stakeholder queries.
  • Sustainability and textile industry knowledge – understanding Better Cotton’s mission and practices.
  • Multilingual communication – ideally Spanish, Portuguese, and English.
  • Effective communication, collaboration, adaptability, problem‑solving, attention to detail, and time management.

Desirable

  • Salesforce CRM proficiency.
  • Power BI or similar tool.
  • Chain of Custody and Traceability.
  • Cultural sensitivity.
  • Initiative and ownership.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary.
  • Remote work and flexible working arrangements.
  • The opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for up to one month per year.
  • Continuous learning and development.
  • Life insurance, dental insurance, medical insurance, meal voucher allowance.
  • 13th salary (bonus) – paid in 2 installments Nov/Dev.
  • Legal protections of local labour law and all other Better Cotton Global Policies apply.
  • 25 days paid annual leave, plus 8–9 bank holidays and a further 3 discretionary days off over Christmas/year end period.
  • A warm, positive working environment where everyone is valued.
  • The opportunity to make your mark and make a difference.

Working Arrangements

The position is full‑time (40 hours per week), offers flexible working arrangements, and will be based remotely in Brazil. The role will be hired through an employer of record acting on behalf of Better Cotton. The role requires occasional travel to meet the team and some stakeholders (up to 15%).

Apply Now

Send us your CV (2 pages maximum) and a brief cover letter (1 page maximum) by or before via this link. In your cover letter, please explain why your experience is specifically relevant to this role at Better Cotton. We want to see your personal style – what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.

Better Cotton does not use artificial intelligence or automated screening tools in its hiring process. Every application is reviewed by our People & Culture team and relevant hiring managers to ensure a fair and human‑led assessment experience.

Our Hiring Process

Initial Screening

Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicants. Internal candidates are encouraged to inform their line manager about their application to promote transparency and help facilitate a smooth transition if selected.

Interviews

If you successfully pass the initial screening, you will be invited for interviews. The interview process at Better Cotton may include one or more rounds of interviews with various stakeholders, such as the hiring manager, team members, and potentially senior management.

Assessment And Testing

Depending on the role, you might be required to complete assessments, technical tests, or skills evaluations to gauge your competency and suitability for the position.

Reference Checks

Once you progress further in the process, reference checks are conducted to validate your work history, skills, and qualifications.

Offer Stage

After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If selected, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details.

About Better Cotton

Better Cotton is a global not‑for‑profit organisation supporting the production of more equitable and sustainable cotton at farm level. We exist to catalyse the cotton farming community with partners, governments, and others to continuously drive positive impact by setting standards and facilitating the supply and demand of more sustainable cotton from farm to brand.

About Our Values

  • Trustworthy (honest, transparent, credible).
  • Integrity (responsible, authentic).
  • Positive (problem‑solving, pragmatic).
  • Engaging (adaptable, inclusive, holistic).
  • Daring (courageous, innovative, game‑changing).

Being you @ Better Cotton

Better Cotton is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal‑opportunity employer with a strong commitment to good practice and transparency in the management of natural, human, and financial resources. We have a zero‑tolerance approach to any attitudes or behaviours that put children or adults at risk of harm. Safeguarding incidents are acts of serious misconduct and are grounds for disciplinary action, up to and including dismissal and referral to relevant authorities for criminal prosecution. Therefore, all offers of employment are subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks.

Overview

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como TÉCNICO DE ENFERMAGEM HEMODINÂMICA que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha uma atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho.

Principais atividades

  1. Participar de dar continuidade às atividades determinadas pela gerencia e coordenação de enfermagem
  2. Exercer a função assistencial, educativa, de pesquisa e social, em concordância com a Gerência de enfermagem
  3. Auxiliar na identificação dos fatores que que favorecem e dificultam o processo de enfermagem
  4. Zelar pelas condições ambientais nde segurança do setor, buscando o bem estar da equipe interdiscilinar
  5. Solucionar as intercorrências , visando um bom padrão de assistência ao cliente.
  6. Prestar assistência aos pacientes, atendendo suas necessidades básicas (higiene e conforto, apoio emocional), zelando pela sua segurança.
  7. Participar de Reuniões com a gerencia, supervisão ou Coordenação de enfermagem, quando solicitado.
  8. Participar da passagem de plantão dentro da sala operatória, checando organização da mesma, conferindo materiais, incluindo equipamentos necessários, ap ato anestésico-cirúrgico e materias que necessitam de data em dia.
  9. Fazer cumprir as normas e rotinas já existentes , incluindo CCIH de acordo com os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP)
  10. Ser assíduo, pontual e disciplinado
  11. Manter chefia direta informada sobre as intercorrências do serviço, solicitando da mesma , quando necessário, as devidas providências.
  12. Responsabilizar-se por todos os materiais do setor, zelando pelo uso adequadamente.
  13. Comunicar ao Enfermeiro supervisor qualquer defeito ou anormalidades ocorridos com materias e equipamentos em sala.
  14. Preencher diariamente o mapa de controle de temperatura da sala de cirurgia.
  15. Avaliar diariamente a necessidade de material permanente( Braçadeira de pressão Não invasiva ?PNI, cabo de oximetro etc) e comunicar à sua chefia imediata para reposição.
  16. Avaliar diariamente a necessidade de material descartavel para consumo (Campos de cobertura cirúrgica, campos de mesa auxiliar)
  17. Realizar diariamente a reposição dos impressos de sala cirúrgica

Senior Software Engineer I, Manage Company

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As we continue expanding beyond Venture Capital into Private Equity markets, we’re building solutions to address the unique challenges of clients managing companies and funds structured as LLCs. These entities vary widely in contractual structures and represent diverse asset classes, requiring a flexible and scalable data model that supports distinct product experiences. Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the next generation of ownership management products. You’ll work closely with product, design, and go‑to‑market teams—as well as directly with top‑tier Private Equity firms and enterprise‑scale clients—to deeply understand their needs and deliver high‑quality technical solutions.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Asset Management LLC Captable team. We launched the Carta LLC product in 2020 and, after discovering a repeatable go‑to‑market motion, have been on a journey to scale it across the entire portfolio of Private Equity companies. We’re also expanding to support a wide range of ownership management workflows.

The scope and impact of each individual on the team are immense. We are biased toward action and believe in the mantra: build → measure → learn. As part of our team, you'll work closely with product managers and designers to understand the motivation (why) behind a customer need, define the scope of work (what), and collaborate with your engineering peers to build solutions (how) that deliver meaningful customer value.

About You

You deeply care about your user and are relentless in your pursuit to build delightful user experiences that wow the customer! You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively who can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype.

  • You have 5+ years of full‑stack or backend engineering experience.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Java, Datadog, REST / GRPC, Kafka, K8s, AWS).
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business and marketing.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.

The Interview Process

Carta follows a standard tech startup interview process, where you will meet with a recruiter and hiring manager first. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list) and virtual interviews. During the process, you can ask questions to people across different parts of the Fund Administration team to learn what kind of work we do and how it lines up with your interests.

title: Solution Architect - Especialista
description:
Selecione a frequência (em dias) de recebimento de alertas: Criar alerta

Cidade: RIO DE JANEIRO

Descrição do perfil
Responsável por fornecer soluções inovadoras para os problemas dos clientes, ou seja, capturar os requisitos de negócios e transformá-los por meio de análise e design em soluções técnicas.


Principais atividades

  • Atuar na análise de requisitos de negócio e na definição de soluções técnicas, com foco em inovação e aderência às necessidades dos clientes;
  • Projetar e definir arquiteturas de sistemas complexos, novos ou legados, considerando escalabilidade, segurança, desempenho e interoperabilidade;
  • Conduzir o levantamento técnico de requisitos junto a stakeholders, traduzindo demandas funcionais e não funcionais em especificações arquiteturais;
  • Elaborar propostas técnicas detalhadas, incluindo modelos de arquitetura, fluxos de integração e definição de componentes;
  • Realizar avaliação de sistemas existentes, identificando oportunidades de refatoração, modernização e integração;
  • Desenvolver planos de testes, estratégias de validação e cronogramas de implementação para as soluções propostas;
  • Diagnosticar e propor soluções para problemas técnicos relacionados à comunicação entre sistemas, serviços e plataformas;
  • Gerenciar projetos técnicos: controle de demandas, avaliação de viabilidade, acompanhamento de entregas e produção de documentação técnica;
  • Aplicar técnicas de inteligência artificial e aprendizado de máquina para apoiar a automação de processos, análise preditiva, classificação de dados e melhoria contínua das soluções desenvolvidas.


Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

  • Conhecimento em Microsoft 365: Administração de ambientes e serviços, com foco em gestão de identidades, grupos, políticas de segurança e conformidade;
  • Power Platform: Administração de ambientes, incluindo Dataverse;
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações em Power Apps (model-driven, canvas e portal);
  • Automação de processos e integração de sistemas utilizando Power Automate;
  • SharePoint Online: Gestão de Site Collections, desenvolvimento de sites modernos, estruturação de conteúdo e aplicação de políticas de governança;
  • Azure: Administração de Resource Groups, monitoramento de serviços, análise de desempenho e resolução de falhas com base em logs e métricas;
  • SQL Server (Azure e On-premises): Execução de queries, administração de bancos de dados, gerenciamento de gateways e publicação de dashboards no Power BI;
  • Power BI: Criação de dashboards interativos, administração de workspaces e integração com fontes de dados diversas;
  • Copilot Studio: Desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em inteligência artificial, incluindo a criação de agentes personalizados para automação de atendimento e integração com sistemas corporativos;
  • Power Virtual Agents (PVA): Criação, treinamento e gestão de chatbots inteligentes, com foco em experiência do usuário e eficiência operacional;
  • Microsoft Fabric: Administração de Data Lakes, organização de dados e suporte a iniciativas de análise avançada;
  • Gestão de mudanças e incidentes: Atuação em processos de ITSM, com foco em governança, rastreabilidade e mitigação de riscos;
  • Inteligência Artificial: Experiência na aplicação de técnicas de IA e machine learning em soluções corporativas, incluindo automação inteligente, análise preditiva, classificação de dados e integração com serviços cognitivos da Microsoft;
  • Obrigatória formação Superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Pós-graduação ou certificações em Inteligência Artificial, Microsoft Power Plat ou áreas afins serão considerados diferenciais.

description:
Nós somos a Fadami Software & Innovation , líder em soluções para concessionárias de rodovias. Há mais de 15 anos entregamos soluções através de sistemas de alta qualidade, seguros e de alto desempenho que movem a vida de milhares de pessoas.

Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Software para definir, evoluir e governar a arquitetura das nossas soluções em um ambiente cloud-native.

Você será referência técnica para os times de produto e engenharia, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança, performance e qualidade.

Stack principal: C#, .NET (preferencialmente .NET 7/8), SQL Server.

Ambiente: Docker, Kubernetes, microserviços, integrações internas e externas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Arquitetura & Design;
  • Definir a arquitetura de referência e roadmap de evolução;
  • Modelar sistemas com boas práticas (DDD, arquitetura hexagonal, modularização, CQRS quando aplicável);
  • Estabelecer padrões de API (REST/GraphQL), contratos e versionamento;
  • Escalabilidade & Performance;
  • Definir estratégias de caching, resiliência e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus);
  • Apoiar times em capacity planning, testes de carga e tuning de aplicações e banco de dados (SQL Server);
  • Boas práticas de Segurança e Governança;
  • Considerar segurança by design (OAuth2/OIDC, gestão de segredos, OWASP Top 10) nas decisões arquiteturais;
  • Apoiar a adequação à LGPD e governança de dados (uso responsável, retenção e privacidade);
  • Cloud & DevOps;
  • Orientar decisões em IaaS/PaaS/Serverless;
  • Apoiar padrões de CI/CD e Infra as Code (Terraform/Bicep);
  • Contribuir para observabilidade ponta a ponta (logs, métricas e tracing);
  • Governança & Cultura Técnica;
  • Documentar decisões arquiteturais (ADRs) e guidelines;
  • Facilitar design reviews, post-mortems e boas práticas de código;
  • Mentorar e influenciar times técnicos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • +5 anos em arquitetura de sistemas ou papel equivalente (Tech Lead/Staff/Sr. Eng.) em produtos de alta disponibilidade;
  • Experiência sólida com C#/.NET (Core/7/8) e SQL Server (otimização e tuning);
  • Vivência prática com containers (Docker/Kubernetes), microserviços e mensageria;
  • Experiência em cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) com serviços gerenciados;
  • Definição de APIs (REST/GraphQL), autenticação/autorização (OAuth2/OIDC);
  • Conhecimentos em observabilidade (logs estruturados, métricas, tracing distribuído);
  • Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD e Infra as Code;
  • Diferenciais:
    • Event Sourcing, outbox pattern, gRPC e Service Mesh;
    • Cache distribuído (Redis), API Gateway (APIM/Kong/YARP);
    • NoSQL (MongoDB, Cosmos DB) e Elasticsearch;
    • Certificações relevantes (Azure Architect, AWS SA, CKA/CKAD).
  • Forte capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica;
  • Liderança técnica: mentoria, influência e facilitação de decisões;
  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Capacidade de alinhar trade-offs técnicos com objetivos de negócio.

description:
Com o objetivo de divulgar o evangelho do Senhor Jesus Cristo ao maior número de pessoas possíveis por meio da programação de TV, temos o departamento de Produção de TV. A instituição mantém dentro de alguns de seus Templos uma ampla estrutura de criação de conteúdos audiovisuais. Tem a função de produzir materiais diários com a equipe operacional para exibição nas emissoras as quais a instituição aluga o espaço. O Editor de Mídia Audiovisual é responsável por editar, finalizar e adequar conteúdos em vídeo e áudio, garantindo qualidade técnica e estética conforme os padrões da emissora. Atua diretamente na montagem de programas, chamadas, reportagens, vinhetas, materiais institucionais e conteúdos para múltiplas plataformas (TV, internet e redes sociais).

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar a edição de vídeo e áudio de programas, reportagens, matérias jornalísticas, chamadas e institucionais.
  • Fazer cortes, inserções, trilhas, legendas, correções de cor, ajustes de som e montagem final conforme roteiro e orientação da produção/direção.
  • Preparar e organizar o material bruto, mantendo arquivos e backups de forma estruturada.
  • Adequar formatos de entrega conforme as especificações técnicas (resoluções, codecs, padrões de TV e plataformas digitais).
  • Trabalhar em sintonia com as equipes de produção, cinegrafia, arte e operação técnica para garantir fluidez e coerência narrativa.
  • Operar softwares de edição não linear (Adobe Premiere).
  • Fazer ajustes de áudio básico (equalização, volume, limpeza de ruídos) e inserção de trilhas ou locuções.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de prazos, qualidade técnica e padrão estético da emissora.
  • Participar do processo de finalização e exportação dos materiais para exibição e arquivamento.

Requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo; curso técnico ou graduação em Produção Audiovisual, Rádio e TV, Cinema, Multimídia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em edição de vídeo e áudio em ambiente profissional (TV, produtora, agência ou estúdio).
  • Domínio de softwares de edição (especificamente Premiere) e conhecimentos de After Effects ou ferramentas de motion serão diferenciais.
  • Boa percepção visual e senso estético, domínio de ritmo e narrativa audiovisual.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob prazos curtos e em equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Organização de arquivos, disciplina de backups e controle de versões de projetos.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em finalização para TV aberta e plataformas digitais.
  • Conhecimento em color grading e design de som.
  • Noções de compressão, exportação e entrega para diversos formatos (broadcast, streaming, redes sociais).

Aqui, energia não nos falta para buscar os melhores resultados, sempre com a segurança em primeiro lugar. Na Origem não existem problemas “dos outros”, trabalhamos unidos como um só time e somos eficientes em tudo que fazemos, evitando desperdícios. Entendemos que só assim continuaremos crescendo, gerando oportunidades para todos e contribuindo para uma transição segura da matriz energética brasileira rumo a uma economia de baixo carbono.

Atuar na gestão do planejamento tático operacional de atividades de manutenção e outras realizadas no ativo, assegurando a execução eficiente das atividades, o monitoramento de cronogramas e recursos, a análise de indicadores de desempenho e a proposição de melhorias nos processos de planejamento.

  1. Gestão do planejamento tático operacional da operação, assegurando a execução eficiente das atividades de médio e curto prazo.
  2. Monitorar a execução dos planos de manutenção (semanal, mensal, trimestral), avaliando o cumprimento de cronogramas, priorizações e recursos.

  4. Análise crítica de indicadores de desempenho, visando identificar desvios, oportunidades e necessidades de correção.
  5. Monitoramento de cronogramas, entregas, projetos e planos de ação, com identificação de pontos críticos e suporte à tomada de decisão para o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas.
  6. Interface com todas as áreas da empresa, promovendo comunicação fluida e alinhamento contínuo com as diretrizes estratégicas.
  7. Elaboração de apresentações gerenciais e executivas periódicas, com foco em andamento, resultados e projeções.

  • Forte raciocínio analítico e pensamento crítico.

  • Proatividade, organização e foco em resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação e bom relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Visão estratégica e capacidade de apresentar dados formatados para facilitar a tomada de decisões.

Equinix enables organizations to access all the right places, partners and possibilities to scale with agility, accelerate the launch of digital services, deliver world‑class experiences and multiply their value, while supporting sustainability goals.

As a Senior Customer Success Analyst, you will strategically drive three core pillars to the business:

  • Relationship with Field Sales customers: provide direct support to strategic, large accounts, ensuring an excellent experience from first contact.
  • Support to sales with a focus on upselling: work side‑by‑side with the commercial team, identifying expansion opportunities and proposing solutions that align with customer needs.
  • Retention and customer loyalty: lead an effective onboarding and maintain continuous follow‑up, analyzing metrics, controlling churn and proactively preventing and resolving issues to ensure customer satisfaction and continued engagement.

Integration of Clients

Use judgment to tailor the best client interaction approach, considering their needs and the scope of the project. Follow the 3‑phase methodology:

  • Phase 1 – Pre‑integration: Perform preparatory activities with all clients.
  • Phase 2 – Initial meeting: Schedule, facilitate and conduct initial integration meetings.
  • Phase 3 – Continuous follow‑up: Establish a regular cadence of contact to monitor client evolution.

You may lead integrations across regions in partnership with other Customer Success Managers (CSMs). Translate internal processes clearly, align expectations and positively influence clients and stakeholders.

Relationship and Personalization

Interact with cross‑functional teams, collect detailed client information to personalize experiences and understand strategic direction. After onboarding, follow up on actions and tasks linked to client goals. Identify trends and ask strategic questions to deepen business understanding.

Adoption and Customer Success Management

Develop, maintain and monitor Customer Success Plans across scopes. Promote product and process adoption based on usage trends. Share product knowledge to empower clients. Collect and manage feedback, proposing continuous improvements based on client insights.

Strategic Collaboration

Collaborate with account teams in pre‑sales discussions, acting as a customer advocate. Ensure smooth transitions across internal areas. Lead special projects with cross‑functional teams, including global accounts. Implement best practices and maintain proactive client contact.

Issue and Escalation Management

Assess and prioritize issues and escalations, ensuring visibility and proper resolution. Work with stakeholders to enforce policies and procedures, communicating resolutions and improvement plans with clarity and empathy.

Account Retention

Partner with sales and management for account oversight. Support contractual obligations, proactively identify churn risks and contribute to retention strategies. Conduct regular operational reviews and manage follow‑up projects.

Main Requirements

  • Completed higher education.
  • Advanced English (interview in English).
  • Prior experience in Customer Success, Post‑sales, Technical Support or Consulting.
  • Experience handling a diverse, extensive B2B client portfolio.
  • Knowledge of customer success metrics (NPS, churn, CSAT, health score).
  • Familiarity with CRM tools and CS platforms (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Previous direct collaboration with the sales team.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in technology companies (SaaS, Cloud, Infrastructure or Data Center).

title: Quality Engineer - Data Test Engineer (IDMC)
description:
Job Title

Quality Engineer - Data Test Engineer (IDMC)

Company: IBM

Introduction

In this role, you will work in one of our IBM Consulting Client Innovation Centers (Delivery Centers), delivering deep technical and industry expertise to a wide range of public and private sector clients worldwide. Our delivery centers provide locally based skills and technical expertise to drive innovation and adoption of new technology.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer at IBM, your technical skills will directly impact the quality of the software we create. You will help each agile iteration reach the next level, whether the testing is manual, automated, or cognitive, ensuring the best deliverables for our clients and IBM.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Data Test Engineer with a strong background in Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) .
  • Responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and accuracy of data across on‑premise and cloud environments.
  • Validate data migration, transformation, and integration processes using Informatica IDMC.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to guarantee seamless data ingestion from multiple sources—including streaming technologies, cloud platforms, and various data stores—while maintaining the highest standards of data quality and consistency.

Essential Job Functions

  • Design, develop, and execute test plans and test cases for data pipelines and workflows built with Informatica IDMC.
  • Perform data validation and transformation testing to verify completeness, consistency, and accuracy between source and target systems.
  • Develop and maintain automated data validation frameworks using Python, SQL, and IDMC’s built‑in tools and APIs.
  • Implement data quality rules and support continuous integration through CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with development, operations, and infrastructure teams to identify and resolve data quality issues.
  • Document test plans, test results, and findings in a clear and traceable manner.
  • Support testing activities related to data migration, profiling, analysis, and transformation.
  • Manage defect tracking and reporting, ensuring timely resolution and transparent communication.
  • Contribute to process improvements and testing best practices within an Agile environment.
  • Work closely with cross‑functional teams to support ongoing data governance and compliance initiatives.

Technical Responsibilities

  • IDMC Development and Testing:

title: Modélisation de tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements de terrain
description:
Modélisation de tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements de terrain

Cadre scientifique: ANR MEGA

Les glissements sous-marins géants km³) sont présents dans les séries sédimentaires Quaternaire des marges continentales passives. Si leurs âges coïncident avec des fluctuations eustatiques, il est encore difficile d’expliquer comment d’aussi grandes ruptures sont générées sur de faibles pentes (<2˚) en l'absence d'un facteur déclenchant tel qu’un séisme. Des hypothèses proposent le rôle de la dissociation des hydrates de gaz et de l’augmentation des pressions interstitielles. Le projet MEGA explorera ces hypothèses grâce aux premières modélisations reliant la stabilité des hydrates de gaz, les variations de pression/température sur le fond marin et la stabilité des pentes. Il s’appuyera sur une comparaison innovante des systèmes du Nil et de l'Amazone, leurs forçages climatiques différant au cours des cycles glaciaires-interglaciaires. En l’absence de cas historiques de méga glissements, MEGA propose de modéliser leurs conséquences en terme de tsunami sur les zones côtières.

L’objectif est de modéliser et simuler numériquement des tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements sous-marins géants en s'appuyant sur le couplage de deux codes numériques existants: Shaltop pour le glissement de terrain, et Freshkiss3D pour la propagation du tsunami.

La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec des géologues de L'Institut des Sciences de la Terre de Paris (ISTeP) et des mathématicien·nes de l'équipe projet ANGE inria Paris/LJLL.

  • Étude de stratégies de couplage numérique entre Shaltop et Freshkiss3D.
  • Simulation de différents scénarios de glissements de terrain géants sur des zones géographiques précises.
  • Déterminer le rôle de la stratification en température de l'océan

La personne recrutée pourra s'appuyer sur l'approche numérique développée lors d'une précédente collaboration (ANR ALBAMAR) et sur les résultats déjà obtenus dans le cadre de ce projet.

Lieux de travail :

ISTeP, Sorbonne Université, Paris. De courts séjours chez les partenaires du projet sont susceptibles d'avoir lieu (UMR Géoazur, UMR EPOC, Linnaeus University en Suède, Fluminense Federal University et Université d'état de Rio de Janeiro au Brésil).

Collaboration :

La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec Sara Lafuerza (ISTeP), Nina Aguillon (LJLL/ Inria Paris), Jacques Sainte-Marie (Inria Paris) et Bernard Di Martino (Université de Corse).

Responsabilités :

La personne recrutée a la charge de développer le couplage numérique et prendra des initiatives pour communiquer les résultats obtenus aux partenaires du projet.

Pilotage/Management :

La personne recrutée pourra être amener à former un/une étudiante en thèse à la simulation numérique.

Principales activés :

  • Implémenter des scénarios de réaction de l'océan à un glissement sous-marin géant
  • Déterminer les paramètres pertinents
  • Présenter l’avancée des travaux aux partenaires
  • Proposer des améliorations de stratégie numérique

Activités complémentaires :

  • Participer à l'écriture des rapports
  • Initier à l'utilisation du code les partenaires du projet
  • Restauration subventionnée
  • Transports publics remboursés partiellement
  • Congés: 7 semaines de congés annuels + 10 jours de RTT (base temps plein) + possibilité d’autorisations d’absence exceptionnelle (ex : enfants malades, déménagement)
  • Possibilité de télétravailet aménagement du temps de travail
  • Équipements professionnels à disposition (visioconférence, prêts de matériels informatiques, etc.)
  • Prestations sociales, culturelles et sportives (Association de gestion des œuvres sociales d'Inria)

description:

Overview

Estamos em busca de um Médico do Trabalho que será responsável em contribuir para promoção da saúde e segurança da força de trabalho, a partir da prevenção, do controle e da eliminação de riscos no ambiente de trabalho com o objetivo de prevenir perdas relacionadas às pessoas e ao patrimônio material da empresa.

Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia!

Traga a sua energia para a Light!

Seus desafios serão:

Responsibilities

  • Realizar exames médicos ocupacionais e clínicos conforme os riscos dos postos de trabalho.
  • Atender emergências médicas e realizar encaminhamentos adequados.
  • Integrar-se à equipe de enfermagem do trabalho, promovendo saúde e segurança.
  • Avaliar acidentes e doenças ocupacionais, emitindo pareceres técnicos.
  • Acompanhar colaboradores acidentados, inclusive em ambiente hospitalar.
  • Analisar postos de trabalho para identificar e minimizar riscos à saúde.
  • Elaborar laudos e relatórios sobre acidentes, doenças e insalubridade.
  • Prestar primeiros socorros e organizar remoções em casos graves.
  • Promover ações de saúde com base em dados epidemiológicos.
  • Participar de auditorias médicas e do gerenciamento de saúde ocupacional.

Qualifications

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina
  • Especialização em Medicina do Trabalho com registro no Conselho Regional de Medicina - RQE.
  • Conhecimento sólido em legislação de Medicina do Trabalho, com ênfase nas Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) do Ministério do Trabalho, nas diretrizes dos Conselhos Federal e Regional de Medicina, da ANAM e do Ministério da Saúde.
  • Domínio de técnicas de gestão de saúde ocupacional, alinhadas às premissas do Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional (PCMSO) da empresa, com foco na prevenção de riscos e promoção da saúde dos colaboradores.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas e softwares de gestão de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho, para registro, análise e acompanhamento de dados ocupacionais.

What we offer

  • Vale Alimentação e/ou Vale Refeição
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados
  • Previdência privada
  • Seguro de vida
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de treinamentos
  • Wellhub

* Todas as nossas vagas também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência ;)

Nosso propósito é transformar a sociedade por meio da nossa energia, levando desenvolvimento e bem-estar por onde passamos todos os dias. E fazer parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros, por mais de um século, só reforça a nossa contribuição com o crescimento econômico e social do país.

Somos uma das maiores empresas privadas do setor elétrico brasileiro que atua, por meio de uma cadeia de valor integrada nos processos de geração, transmissão e distribuição de energia para 31 municípios do Rio de Janeiro, além da comercialização de energia para todo o Brasil.

Aqui, os desafios são diários e queremos que os nossos mais de 4 milhões de clientes tenham sempre a melhor experiência de atendimento, com serviços de alta qualidade.

Temos um time diverso de colaboradores campeões, que seguem juntos, colocando em prática o nosso propósito. Gente que sonha grande, quebra barreiras e faz história. Afinal, cuidar da energia que transforma a vida de tanta gente faz parte do nosso DNA!

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

  • Zelar pela correta utilização do uniforme e EPIs, asseio pessoal, materiais e produtos, conforme padronização de acordo com procedimento, orientação do superior hierárquico e normas de segurança;

  • Organizar a distribuição da equipe de trabalho, liderando equipes, definindo as tarefas a serem executadas e alocando nos setores;
  • Conferir e orientar os funcionários no correto preenchimento de Relatórios, durante as rondas no prédio e ao final do plantão;
  • Realizar checklist nos novos colaboradores conforme rotina estabelecida, esclarecendo sobre as normas disciplinares, instruções de trabalho, normas de segurança, visitação dos setores, visando adequada ambientação;
  • Conferir o abastecimento do material e distribuição quando necessário, checar o DML (depósito de material de limpeza) e carrinho funcional, para que o colaborador execute suas funções diárias;
  • Realizar o Checklist de limpeza em formulários específicos avaliando o resultado da limpeza/higienização, orientando a equipe quando detectada falha, assegurando o protocolo e padronização estabelecidos;
  • Monitorar a conduta disciplinar da equipe, orientando e corrigindo comportamentos inadequados, aplicando as punições cabíveis conforme código de conduta;
  • Atentar para a aplicação prática dos conhecimentos adquiridos nos treinamentos realizados no contrato, para multiplicação das práticas adequadas;
  • Garantir a correta utilização e distribuição do uniforme e EPIs, e orientar quanto ao adequado asseio pessoal dos auxiliares de limpeza, seguindo normas e procedimentos estabelecidos;
  • Preencher controle de EPI, registrando o equipamento disponibilizado ao colaborador, colhendo assinatura, conforme orientação a normas de segurança;
  • Verificar etiquetas dos produtos no estoque e diluídos, fazendo conferência de prazos de validade, conforme padrão estabelecido;
  • Monitorar o suprimento de materiais e equipamentos em estoque no contrato, sinalizar necessidade ou efetuar solicitações necessárias, realizar a conferência no ato do recebimento e organizar a alocação;
  • Receber e assinar os atestados dos colaboradores, encaminhando para o superior, para controle de faltas e tratativa adequada de abonos;
  • Monitorar assiduidade e pontualidade dos colaboradores através do acompanhamento da Folha e Cartão de ponto;
  • Higienizar o material e utensílios utilizados no plantão anterior, organizando e acondicionando em local específico para continuidade das atividades previstas;
  • Ler e registrar informações no livro de ocorrência, no início e ao final do plantão, visando adequada continuidade das atividades do contrato;
  • Fazer a passagem de plantão em conjunto com a liderança do outro plantão, fazendo a ronda nos setores, sinalizando as ocorrências, registrando as informações, visando adequada continuidade das atividades no contrato;
  • Fazer ronda nos setores orientando os auxiliares na execução das tarefas, na correta aplicação da técnica de limpeza, corrigindo postura, delegando atribuições e acompanhando a execução, a fim de avaliar o resultado conforme padrão estabelecido;
  • Encaminhar e acompanhar o funcionário, no caso de Acidente de Trabalho ou algum tipo de ocorrência médica, informando ao superior hierárquico, segurança do trabalho e os familiares sobre ocorrido;
  • Realizar a diluição de produtos químicos de limpeza corretamente, seguindo as recomendações de segurança do trabalho, bem como também as orientações fornecidas pelo fabricante do(s) produto(s), FISPQs e treinamentos aplicados;
  • Comparecer em audiência como prepostos, representando a empresa, em processos judiciais e administrativos, caso haja requisição do departamento jurídico;

title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Email Marketing Manager role at Darkroom

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth‑stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e‑commerce marketplace, direct‑to‑consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high‑impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest‑growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results‑driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About The Role

We are looking for a highly innovative, data‑driven Email Marketing Manager, who’s motivated by the challenge of working with some of the fastest growing e‑commerce and digital brands. You will join a team of email, SMS and retention marketing industry experts to drive client revenue, partner with internal cross‑functional colleagues to go deeper on understanding our customer needs and insights with a specific focus on deepening retention and building loyalty. You will lead a cross‑functional team to build creative strategies in email and SMS campaign development to help our clients grow.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Spain, Mexico, Portugal, and Brazil.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, with hands‑on retention experience.
  • You immerse yourself in scaling personalized D2C/e‑commerce email and SMS programs that build deep customer relationships for clients.
  • You can creatively message the value propositions of any brand’s product catalog to create email and SMS campaigns that customers find to be engaging, informative, and persuasive.
  • You’re passionate about developing creative customer journeys and loyalty programs that drive loyalty and lifetime value.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo (or a similar ESP’s) including list segmentation, lifecycle drip automations, and triggered events. Additionally, you have knowledge of Shopify and their tech stack options such as Privy, JustUno, Yotpo, Octane AI, etc.
  • You have developed SMS and loyalty programming strategies and have experience working with SMS platforms such as Attentive, PostScript, SMSBump, or Klaviyo.
  • You’re used to working in a fast paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You love making data driven decisions and excel at turning analytics into actionable SMS and email strategies that drive client revenue.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.
  • You have experience developing and executing customer loyalty programs that enhance LTV.
  • You’ve had at least one direct report before and exceptional leadership skills working with cross‑functional teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

A Day in the Life

  • Serve as the primary retention lead for select clients, working to develop best‑in‑class retention strategies. On a bi‑weekly basis, you will lead meetings with clients to discuss current and future initiatives.
  • Report on strategic KPIs for clients, creating insights and actionable recommendations to grow client retention engagement and revenue.
  • Develop strategic campaign calendars and prioritize projects and initiatives designed to scale your clients’ email, SMS, loyalty and subscription programs.
  • Project manage and delegate campaign briefs to your team, consisting of both retention specialists and designers.
  • Review all client briefs and designs for approval before they are sent to the client to ensure campaign quality and accuracy.
  • Assign segmentation and QA email and SMS campaigns ensuring flawless delivery to customer audiences.
  • Execute on automation/flow logic set‑up, pop‑up builds, and app integrations.
  • Coordinate cross‑departmentally with the Growth, Digital, and Marketplaces teams to develop cohesive campaigns that drive client growth.

Working at Darkroom

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: People Operations Generalist
description:
WHAT WE DO MATTERS:

At The Knot Worldwide, we champion celebration - and that starts with celebrating our people. Our employees are passionate dreamers, thoughtful doers, and lifelong learners who power meaningful moments for millions around the world. We’re united by authentic connection, shared purpose, and a deep commitment to the global community we serve. Here, flexibility and belonging go hand in hand with high performance. We believe the best ideas come from empowered teams: those who consistently collaborate with intention to design solutions, spark ideas, and drive impact. Our people are at the heart of our success.

Please submit your CV in English.

ABOUT THE ROLE AND OUR TEAM:

The People Operations Generalist role at TKWW will provide some operational support to People BPs, but with a renewed focus on process standardization, HR systems management, and data ownership. People Operations is responsible for setting the global standards, processes, and policies for all employee lifecycle changes, and the Generalist will play a key role in ensuring these processes are executed flawlessly across all regions . The People Operations Generalist will manage administrative tasks related to the employee lifecycle (such as onboarding, offboarding, promotions, merit adjustments, etc.), but with an increased emphasis on process alignment, systems management, and data integrity. As the "guardians of the data," People Operations is accountable for the accuracy and reliability of employee information, and you will help maintain this high standard by ensuring that all data and lifecycle changes are recorded and updated correctly.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Employee Lifecycle Management: Manage and execute the end-to-end employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, promotions, merit adjustments, and employee transfers. Ensure all changes are documented accurately in HR systems, in employee files, in documented employee memos, and aligned with company policies and local labor laws.
  • HR Systems Management & Data Integrity: Oversee and maintain employee data within the HR systems (e.g., HRIS, ATS, in collaboration with payroll). As a key member of the People Ops team, you will ensure that all employee lifecycle changes are accurately tracked and aligned with standard operating procedures. You will be responsible for ensuring the integrity of employee data, making sure it is up-to-date and reflects changes accurately across systems.
  • Process Standardization & Execution: Follow and execute standardized People Operations processes for all employee lifecycle events, ensuring compliance with global policies and local regulations. Support the continuous improvement of these processes to increase efficiency and streamline workflows.
  • Collaboration with Total Rewards: Support the People Operations team in areas related to Total Rewards, including compensation and benefits. You may assist with administering benefits programs, ensuring accuracy in pay and benefit-related changes, and liaising with external vendors or partners for benefits enrollment and compensation adjustments.
  • Ad Hoc People Operations Support: Provide general support to the broader People Operations function on various initiatives, including but not limited to compliance projects, mandatory compliance training, and other HR programs.
  • Regional & Global Partnership:
    • Work closely with global People Ops teams to ensure processes and initiatives are aligned across regions. In the absence of a local HRBP or People Ops team, you will be relied upon to handle a broad range of employee needs and act as a key resource for your region.
    • You will have the opportunity to partner with broader teams to provide additional support in areas such as Total Rewards (compensation and benefits), new hire orientation .
    • You may be asked to provide local support for answering employee inquiries, providing guidance on company policies, benefits or other essential information, and acting as a liaison between employees and the global People teams.

SUCCESSFUL PEOPLE OPERATIONS GENERALIST CANDIDATES HAVE:

  • Experience: 3-5 years of experience in an HR Generalist, or People Operations role, with strong experience supporting employee lifecycle management processes (onboarding, offboarding, promotions, etc.), HR systems management, and compliance.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus.
  • HR Systems & Data Management: Familiarity with HRIS systems and experience with data entry, system management, and reporting. Strong attention to detail and a passion for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of employee data.
  • Process-Oriented Mindset: Experience in implementing and executing standardized HR processes, with a focus on streamlining workflows and maintaining compliance with global and local policies.
  • Regional Expertise (where applicable): Experience working in specific geographic regions with an understanding of local labor laws and HR practices. In regions where you are the sole People Ops representative, the ability to take ownership of various HR functions, including performance management and employee relations, will be critical.
  • Total Rewards Knowledge: A basic understanding of compensation, benefits, and rewards programs is a plus, particularly in how these programs impact the employee lifecycle.
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to liaise between employees, People BPs, and other key stakeholders. Comfortable working across cultures and with diverse teams.
  • Adaptability & Problem-Solving: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple tasks simultaneously. You should be proactive, adaptable, and able to problem-solve as challenges arise.
  • Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail, especially when handling employee data, documentation, and system updates.
  • Educational Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. HR certifications (e.g., SHRM-CP, PHR) are a plus.

WORK MODEL: This role is fully remote and not tied to any specific office location. While there are no regular in-office requirements, we encourage our remote team members to gather intentionally for key company and team events to stay connected and engaged.

At The Knot Worldwide, we believe you are more than a resume and invite you to go for it, take the leap of faith, and apply for this job if it sparks your passion to join TKWW and make a difference!

WHAT YOU LOVE ABOUT US:

We believe in a wide range of holistic offerings to support our employees so that they can live our values day in and day out. From mental wellbeing, physical health and financial planning, to engaging perks and discounts, we are in the business of celebrating and supporting the Moments that Matter both in and out of the “office”. We offer flexible vacation, generous parental leave and prioritize initiatives that support the growth, development, and happiness of our people.

is our approach to hybrid work. It’s designed to support how we work best: combining the flexibility we value with meaningful opportunities to connect in person. Whether a role is or not, we believe in purposeful moments to come together, build strong relationships, and drive bold ideas forward.

  • For roles, this includes regular in-office time to foster collaboration and connection.
  • For roles not eligible for in-office expectations , we support connection through virtual collaboration and intentional gatherings.

To facilitate in-person collaboration, we have office spaces in Barcelona, Spain; Delhi, India; Galway, Ireland; London, England; New York, NY; and Washington, D.C.

In addition to federal law requirements, The Knot Worldwide complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. The Knot Worldwide expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

Privacy Notice: The Knot Worldwide processes your personal data to evaluate your application, based on the legal ground of taking steps prior to entering into a potential employment contract. Only the data strictly necessary for this purpose is collected. In some cases, your data may also be processed based on TKWW’s legitimate interests (e.g., to improve recruitment practices or manage candidate pools), to which you can object at any time. You have the right to access, rectify, or delete your data, and to object to certain uses. To learn more about your rights, please consult our Privacy Policy.

A NEORIS, agora parte da EPAM, é uma Aceleradora Digital que ajuda empresas a darem o próximo passo em direção ao futuro. Temos mais de 20 anos de experiência como parceiros digitais de algumas das maiores empresas do mundo. Somos mais de 4.000 profissionais em 11 países, com uma cultura multicultural e de startup, na qual cultivamos a inovação e o aprendizado contínuo para criar soluções de alto valor para nossos clientes.

Localidade: Rio de Janeiro - Centro

Descrição de Cargo

O Scrum Master será responsável por facilitar a implementação das práticas ágeis em projetos SAP, promovendo a colaboração entre equipes e garantindo a entrega contínua de valor.

Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir cerimônias Scrum, incluindo Daily Stand-ups, Planning, Review e Retrospective, assegurando que as reuniões sejam produtivas e focadas.
  • Servir como guardião dos princípios ágeis, promovendo a cultura de melhoria contínua dentro da equipe e da organização.

  • Familiaridade com os módulos SAP e suas interdependências.

Diferenciais

Sobre o Projeto

O projeto tem como objetivo desenvolver uma solução digital para gestão logística e ambiental de resíduos sólidos, utilizando tecnologias como blockchain e contratos inteligentes. A plataforma será testada junto a empresas parceiras e busca aumentar a transparência, rastreabilidade e eficiência na logística reversa pós-consumo.

Atividades do Bolsista

O(a) bolsista TT-3 será responsável por apoiar a implementação, manutenção e operação da solução digital, incluindo:

  • Suporte Técnico Operacional: atendimento de primeiro nível a usuários, acompanhamento de coletas e rotinas operacionais, monitoramento do funcionamento da plataforma.
  • Testes e Validação: execução de testes manuais, registro de erros em ferramentas como Trello/Notion/GitHub Issues, simulação de cenários de uso real (incluindo APIs logísticas como Lalamove).
  • Coleta de Feedbacks & Documentação: interação com usuários, organização de tutoriais, FAQs e manuais de apoio.
  • Monitoramento de Indicadores: análise de métricas como tempo de resposta, número de falhas e nível de utilização da plataforma.
  • Interface com Equipes: apoio a times de desenvolvimento, atendimento e comercial, participação em reuniões de sprint e planejamento.

Requisitos

Formação técnica ou superior: Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência de dados ou áreas correlatas.

Habilidade para:

  • Executar testes funcionais
  • Registrar e documentar processos
  • Interagir com usuários e dar suporte técnico

Desejável conhecimento em: Node.js, Python, HTML, Banco de dados (MySQL, Firebase Firestore), Ferramentas de versionamento (Git) e metodologias Agile, Docker/Kubernetes (diferencial).

Impacto

Ao integrar a equipe, você contribuirá diretamente para:
